newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Top Glory Holdings to set US$100 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Top Glory Holdings to set US$100 mln loan.

text.p: Top Glory Holding Co Ltd's US$100 million loan facility is expected to be launched into general syndication next week, bankers said Tuesday.
The underwriting stage is nearly completed, they said.
The amortising loan has a final maturity of three years with an average life of 2.25 years. Repayment is in four equal semi-annual instalments with a grace period of 1.5 years.
It pays an interest margin of 115 basis points over the three- or six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Underwriting fees are 11.25 basis points for senior co-arrangers committing US$15 million or more and 5.625 basis points for co-arrangers committing US$12 million or more.
Lead management fees are 45 basis points.
The deal is secured by a financial convenant which states that the borrower must remain a wholly-owned subsidiary of China National Cereals, Oil and Foodstuff Import and Export Corp (COFCO).
Societe Generale Asia is the sole arranger.
Top Glory Holdings is the parent company of Top Glory International Holdings, which is involved in property investment and food-related business.
